issues.title: F1: Manual patient lookup
issues.body:
**Feature F1** | Priority: **Must** | Type: Baseline | Story points: **1** | Proposed sprint: **2**

**User story**
As an ICU doctor, I want to enter a patient ID and see the predicted status, so that I can check one patient quickly.

**Description**
Enter a patient ID to see predicted status

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] A valid patient ID shows the predicted status label
- [ ] An unknown ID shows a clear error message
- [ ] Uses the shared status mapping from F8
- [ ] Baseline behaviour verified and any defects fixed

**Definition of done**
- [ ] Feature branch + pull request linked to this issue (`Closes #...`)
- [ ] Reviewed by at least one other member
- [ ] Acceptance criteria above checked
- [ ] Docs/README updated if behaviour changed
- [ ] No real patient data; 'not for clinical use' notice intact

_Source: Milestone 1 report, Section 6.1. Criteria are a draft for refinement in Sprint 0 planning._
issues.description: Enter a patient ID to see predicted status

issues.title: F3: Status classification
issues.body:
**Feature F3** | Priority: **Must** | Type: Baseline | Story points: **1** | Proposed sprint: **1**

**User story**
As an ICU nurse, I want every reading classified into a status level, so that I can see how urgent each patient is.

**Description**
Decision Tree model classifies each reading into 5 levels (Normal to Critical / Outlier)

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Decision Tree loads from the documented model location (no hard-coded paths)
- [ ] Five status classes returned (0 Normal ... 4 Outlier)
- [ ] Baseline accuracy (87.1%) reproduced after F6/F9

**Definition of done**

- [ ] Reviewed by at least one other member

issues.title: F9: Rigorous model evaluation
issues.body:
**Feature F9** | Priority: **Must** | Type: New | Story points: **5** | Proposed sprint: **0**

**User story**
As the team, we want a reproducible, trustworthy model evaluation, so that alert quality is measured rather than assumed (O3, AC3).

**Description**
Reproduce original results, then improve evaluation: fixed seeds, stratified 5-fold CV, recall-focused tuning, class weighting; evaluate Isolation Forest quantitatively

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Baseline report results reproduced from the repository (Sprint 0 spike)
- [ ] Fixed random seeds; stratified 5-fold cross-validation
- [ ] Targets: Critical recall >= 0.90 (CV mean), Moderate recall >= 0.70, macro F1 >= 0.88, false alerts on normal <= 10%
- [ ] Isolation Forest evaluated quantitatively, not only visually
- [ ] Results written up in the model evaluation report (D3)

**Definition of done**
- [ ] Feature branch + pull request linked to this issue (`Closes #...`)
- [ ] Reviewed by at least one other member
- [ ] Acceptance criteria above checked
- [ ] Docs/README updated if behaviour changed
- [ ] No real patient data; 'not for clinical use' notice intact

_Source: Milestone 1 report, Section 6.1. Criteria are a draft for refinement in Sprint 0 planning._
issues.description: Reproduce original results, then improve evaluation: fixed seeds, stratified 5-fold CV, recall-focused tuning, class weighting; evaluate Isolation Forest quantitatively
